scripts.fallow:audit: sh -c 'set --; test -f .fallow-dead-code-baseline.json && set -- "$@" --dead-code-baseline .fallow-dead-code-baseline.json; test -f .fallow-health-baseline.json && set -- "$@" --health-baseline .fallow-health-baseline.json; if test -f .fallow-dead-code-baseline.json || test -f .fallow-health-baseline.json; then base="${FALLOW_AUDIT_BASE:-$(git merge-base HEAD "$(git symbolic-ref -q --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo origin/main)" 2>/dev/null || git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)}"; set -- "$@" --fail-on-baseline-growth --baseline-base "$base"; fi; fallow audit --format json --quiet --explain --gate-marker agent "$@"'
scripts.fallow:coverage: npm run test && npm run fallow
scripts.fallow:dead-code: sh -c 'if test -f .fallow-dead-code-baseline.json; then fallow dead-code --baseline .fallow-dead-code-baseline.json --fail-on-stale-baseline; else echo "fallow:dead-code: no .fallow-dead-code-baseline.json - nothing to check for staleness; run fallow:raise to record one" >&2; fi'
scripts.fallow:ratchet: sh -c 'if test -f .fallow-health-baseline.json; then fallow health --coverage coverage/coverage-final.json --baseline .fallow-health-baseline.json --fail-on-stale-baseline; else echo "fallow:ratchet: no .fallow-health-baseline.json - gating at zero findings (the greenfield wall); run fallow:raise to record the current level" >&2; fallow health --coverage coverage/coverage-final.json; fi'
scripts.fallow:raise: sh -c 'fallow health --coverage coverage/coverage-final.json --report-only --save-baseline .fallow-health-baseline.json; fallow dead-code --save-baseline .fallow-dead-code-baseline.json; test -f .fallow-health-baseline.json && test -f .fallow-dead-code-baseline.json && if command -v biome >/dev/null 2>&1; then biome check --write --unsafe --linter-enabled=false .fallow-health-baseline.json .fallow-dead-code-baseline.json; elif command -v prettier >/dev/null 2>&1; then prettier --write .fallow-health-baseline.json .fallow-dead-code-baseline.json; else for f in .fallow-health-baseline.json .fallow-dead-code-baseline.json; do [ -z "$(tail -c 1 "$f")" ] || echo >> "$f"; done; fi'
